items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: We became friends like that, up to his death

ctx.x: The Regina Dance Hall. And there I made some wonderful friends. I met a wonderful trumpet player who was -- he was doing his military service in one of the bands. Pardon me. His name was Alfonse Koks. He was of Dutch origin. Not German, Dutch, origin. His name was Koks.

And he played violin-cello, as well. He was in the second orchestra, but he only played violin-cello in the orchestra. When we were over for the night after the show, he came over and spoke to me, he said, "Well, I play trumpet as well." He said, "I'm first brass at the conservatory."
